landing.faq.title: Nano Banana 2.1 FAQ
landing.faq.description: Answers about the model, credits and how this site works.
landing.faq.what.question: What is Nano Banana 2.1?
landing.faq.what.answer: Nano Banana 2.1 (gemini-nano-banana-2.1) is Google's newest Flash-tier image generation and editing model in the Gemini 3 family. It improves realism, prompt adherence, text rendering and character consistency over earlier versions.
landing.faq.versions.question: How is Nano Banana 2.1 different from Nano Banana 2 and Pro?
landing.faq.versions.answer: It keeps Flash speed and cost while improving image quality at 1K, 2K and 4K, removing tiling artifacts on wide formats and rendering text and infographics more accurately. It is reported to be close to 3x faster than the previous Flash image model.
landing.faq.resolution.question: Which resolutions and aspect ratios does Nano Banana 2.1 support?
landing.faq.resolution.answer: Output is available at 1K, 2K and 4K. Aspect ratios are 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 3:2, 2:3, 5:4, 4:5, 21:9, 4:1, 1:4, 8:1 and 1:8.
landing.faq.references.question: How many reference images can I upload?
landing.faq.references.answer: Up to 14 per request, as JPG, PNG or WebP files of up to 10 MB each. Use them to edit a photo, merge several sources or keep a character consistent.
landing.faq.credits.question: How many credits does one image cost?
landing.faq.credits.answer: It depends on resolution: 25 credits at 1K, 35 at 2K and 75 at 4K, plus 2 credits per reference image. The exact cost is always shown on the Generate button before you start.
landing.faq.commercial.question: Can I use Nano Banana 2.1 images commercially?
landing.faq.commercial.answer: Yes, as long as your prompts and uploads follow our Acceptable Use Policy and respect other people's rights. Images include Google's invisible SynthID watermark.

landing.about.title: What is Nanobanana 2.1?
landing.about.p1: Nano Banana 2.1 is the popular name for gemini-nano-banana-2.1, Google's latest lightweight image generation and editing model in the Gemini 3 family. It belongs to the Flash tier, so it is built for speed and low cost, yet its images hold up at full 4K resolution.
landing.about.p2: It replaces Nano Banana 2 and Nano Banana Pro as the everyday choice. The 2.1 update targets the problems people hit in real work: natural skin and material detail, closer prompt adherence, text that is spelled and laid out correctly, and characters that stay the same from one image to the next. Wide and panoramic frames at 2K and 4K no longer show tiling artifacts.
landing.about.p3: nanobanana-21.com puts Nano Banana 2.1 into a simple web studio. Write a prompt, add up to 14 reference images if you want, choose an aspect ratio and a resolution, and the image arrives in seconds. You need no API key, no code and no GPU.
landing.about.spec.speed_value: Close to 3x the previous Flash model
landing.tips.title: Prompt tips for better Nano Banana 2.1 results
landing.tips.t1.title: Lead with the subject
landing.tips.t1.body: Start with what the picture is about, then add setting, light and mood. "A ceramic mug on a linen tablecloth, soft window light" beats a list of adjectives.
landing.tips.t2.title: Quote the exact text
landing.tips.t2.body: Nano Banana 2.1 renders text well when it knows the wording. Write it in quotes and say where it goes, for example a shop sign that reads "OPEN LATE".
landing.tips.t3.title: Name your references
landing.tips.t3.body: With several uploads, refer to them by order: "the jacket from image 2 on the model from image 1". Clear roles give cleaner fusions.
landing.tips.t4.title: Edit in small steps
landing.tips.t4.body: Change one thing per request and build on the last result. Small edits keep faces, products and layouts stable.
landing.use_cases.ecommerce.body: Turn one product photo into lifestyle scenes, clean white-background packshots and seasonal banners, with enough resolution for zoom.
landing.use_cases.social.body: Make 9:16 stories, 4:5 feed posts and thumbnails with legible headlines, and keep a recurring character recognizable across a series.
landing.use_cases.marketing.body: Produce campaign variants in every format from 8:1 banners to 21:9 key visuals, and localize posters without retyping the artwork.
landing.use_cases.design.body: Build mood boards from many references, sketch interiors and explain ideas with infographics, maps and labeled diagrams.
landing.faq.free.question: Can I try Nano Banana 2.1 for free?
landing.faq.free.answer: Yes. You can create 1 image for free without an account, and get 1 more free image after you sign up. Free trial images use Nano Banana 2 Lite at 1K; paid images use Nano Banana 2.1 in up to 4K, with credit packs from $9.90.
landing.faq.apikey.question: Do I need a Gemini API key?
landing.faq.apikey.answer: No. nanobanana-21.com connects to the model for you. Sign in, write a prompt and generate. There is nothing to install and no code to write.
